title: Ghent craftsmen distribution during the 14th century
descriptions: Spatial distribution of craftsmen of a specific craft in the 14th century. This layer was made in the framework of the ERC project ‘Healthscaping Urban Europe: Bio-Power, Space and Society, 1200-1500’ (n° 724114), on the basis of David Nicholas' works. More information is to be found in the Metadata file.
